findings.value: A rooftop bar and Neapolitan pizza restaurant in London Fields, Hackney, with views over London. It has DJs at weekends.

evidence.quote: Netil360, rooftop bar with panoramic views over London, serving up natural wine, craft beer, cocktails, and stone-baked Neapolitan pizza.
Netil360 Rooftop Bar & Pizza Restaurant in London Fields, Hackney, East London
Each weekend, a curated lineup of DJs brings soul, hip-hop, house, disco and global sounds

findings.value: DJs at weekends, and a regular Thursday jazz night listed on the venue's site.

notes: Sources: the venue's own home page and What's On page (both current; the site shows hours and a Christmas menu, no closure or reopening news, so no status finding). 'Jazz Thursdays' is a menu item only; no page describes it, so treat jazz as thin. No press review found: WebSearch budget was used up before this run's searches. The venue's own about page returned 404.
